reviews.title: Cheap is not always good-John Paul Patten and Stephen Shurrock don’t care
reviews.body:
Cheap is not always good – Day 7 without service

Lebara may offer cheap mobile plans, but the true cost becomes clear when something goes wrong. I have now been without calls, texts or mobile data for seven days, despite continuing to pay for a monthly plan I cannot use.

I have repeatedly contacted Lebara and escalated my complaint to CEO Stephen Shurrock and Business Operations Director John-Paul Patten. Despite senior management being informed of the suspected fraud, account-security concerns and serious impact of the service bar, my service remains suspended.

A Lebara representative called me and promised to call back, but the callback never happened. Instead of meaningful action, Lebara continues to repeat the same generic, apparently automated response that the matter has been “escalated”.

I still have no answers about when my service will be restored, whether my account or number was compromised, what investigation has taken place, or why my requested deadlock letter has not been provided.

My disabled mother recently suffered a fall, and I was unable to contact her carers because my phone remained barred. Lebara knows about this safeguarding impact but has still failed to act.

I will continue posting factual daily updates until something is done. Cheap is not always good—especially when poor customer service leaves you paying for a service you cannot use.

reviews.title: Fifth day without any service…
reviews.body: Onto fifth day without any service because they have identified unusual usage patterns associated with my number that may be considered spam or business-related usage. No idea what that means. I have not done anything new. Now I cannot receive texts and therefore no 2 factor authentication for banking etc. I cannot use any internet when out, no gps, unable to use the location service to track my daughter, her school cannot call me in case of emergency, I can’t use qr codes to pay (carpark for example, I was stuck in one n Wednesday morning unable to pay) open apps, I can’t pick up packages because I need to receive a text from InPost Nothing. They just removed all services without any warning. I was told Thursday and then Friday and then Saturday they would sort it. They have not. I have not heard from them. I’m so disappointed with their lack of care. And they refuse to give me my pac code because my account is blocked. I’m stuck without a phone. Terrible terrible service
